# metaboData

> Example data sets for metabolomics analyses

### Installation

The package can be install directly from CRAN using the following:

``` rm
install.packages('metaboData')
```

Alternatively, the development version can be installed from GitHub:

`{r,eval=false) devtools::install_github('aberHRML/metaboData',build_vignettes = TRUE)`

### Learn more

The package documentation can be browsed online at
<https://aberHRML.github.io/metaboData/>.

If this is your first time using `metaboData` see the
[vignette](https://aberHRML.github.io/metaboData/articles/metaboData.html)
for information on how to get started.

If you believe you’ve found a bug in `metaboData`, please file a bug
(and, if possible, a [reproducible
example](https://reprex.tidyverse.org)) at
<https://github.com/aberHRML/metaboData/issues>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`abr1`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/abr1.md) :
  The abr1 dataset
- [`availableDataSets()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/availableDataSets.md)
  : Available data sets
- [`availableFiles()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/availableFiles.md)
  : Available files for a data set
- [`dataSets()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/dataSets.md)
  : Available data sets for a given technique
- [`description()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/description.md)
  : Data set description
- [`downloadDataSet()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/downloadDataSet.md)
  : Download a data set
- [`downloadFiles()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/downloadFiles.md)
  : Download specific files from a data set
- [`filePaths()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/filePaths.md)
  : Data set file paths
- [`runinfo()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/runinfo.md)
  : Data set sample information
- [`techniques()`](https://aberhrml.github.io/metaboData/reference/techniques.md)
  : Available data set techniques
